_comment: See s1_reporter.json. Here the police also report -- likewise a human, not an agent.

reporter.name: Milos Varga (fictional)
reporter.statement: Squall line hit just after we left Berlin Hbf. Coming out of the tunnel at Heidestrasse a tree came down across both tracks and took the overhead line with it. We hit the tree and the collapsed mast at about 40 km/h and stopped. Line is dead, three wagons visibly damaged, including the tank wagon W05. Europacity apartment blocks within sight.
